subject: Stark Industries — security questionnaire activation & SOC 2 / HIPAA clarification
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@starkind.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: next steps for security questionnaire + SOC 2 / HIPAA status

Hi Dana — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can keep procurement moving: 

- Key asks you mentioned: SOC 2 report availability, data residency (US-only), and whether Redwood can sign a HIPAA BAA for PHI flows.
- We recommended initiating the SIG/CAIQ so your security team can review technical controls; we can prefill to save you time.
- Immediate deliverable: a prefilled SIG JSON + an evidence map and a short list of clarifying questions from our security team.

Could you confirm the right security contact we should send the questionnaire to (we captured security@starkind.com but want to be sure), and whether Stark prefers SIG or the CAIQ matrix? If you want HIPAA scoping limited to a single product line, say the word and we’ll scope accordingly.

Attached: redwood_sig_prefill_v1.json (prefill) and a one-tab evidence map template (requested_evidence_map.xlsx) — these are starter artifacts only.

Proposed timeline: we can ship a refined prefill + evidence map within 48 hours if we have the correct security contact and confirmation on SIG vs CAIQ.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our security lead once you confirm so they can answer technical evidence questions directly.

Connor O'Brien
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0191
redwood.ai

--
Attachment: redwood_sig_prefill_v1.json (application/json)
Attachment: requested_evidence_map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@starkind.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@starkind.com
Date: 2027-09-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: next steps for security questionnaire + SOC 2 / HIPAA status

Hi Connor — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers and a couple of asks from our side: 

- Security contact: please send the questionnaire to security@starkind.com (primary) and cc me. Our security manager is Jorge Alvarez on that alias.
- Preference: SIG is fine; if you have a CAIQ prefill it’s okay but SIG is our preferred format for cloud vendor reviews.
- SOC 2: we require a vendor SOC 2 Type II report (past 12 months) or SOC 2 in progress plus compensating evidence if it’s not yet available. Can Redwood provide the latest report or an auditor letter?
- HIPAA: this will only apply if we ingest PHI from a specific pilot product. If we reach that stage, we’ll request a BAA — for now, please outline what parts of the platform would be covered under a BAA and whether your on-hosting options keep data in our VPC.

One more operational ask: can you provide the prefill as both JSON (for our tooling) and an exported PDF we can put in our ticketing system? Jorge prefers PDFs in the ticket.

If you can get the updated prefill and the evidence map back to us by EOD Thursday (9/16), I’ll try to get Jorge to start the document review the following week.

Thanks,
Dana Reynolds
Director, IT Security
Stark Industries
Dana.Reynolds@starkind.com

On another note — do you have a data residency option that guarantees US-only processing? We need that confirmed for our procurement checklist.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@starkind.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T12:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: next steps for security questionnaire + SOC 2 / HIPAA status

Hi Dana — looping in Marissa (Security & Compliance) to handle the SOC 2 and HIPAA specifics. Quick answers from ops side: 

- We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12 months; Marissa will confirm exact dates and whether a redacted auditor letter is preferred.
- Data residency: hosted Redwood Inference accounts can be pinned to our US-only region; for Dedicated/Private we can provide on-prem or VPC deployment options. Marissa, can you confirm the short phrasing we should include in the evidence map about US-only processing?
- Deliverables: Connor — we’ll produce the SIG prefill as JSON + a PDF export and an updated evidence map. We’ll also include a one-page note that describes BAA scope options for HIPAA.

Dana — is there a specific format or filename Jorge prefers for the PDF? We can name it Stark_SIG_prefill_v1.pdf to match your ticketing conventions.

Thanks — we’ll aim for the 9/16 EOD window and will escalate if anything slips.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

--
Note: Marissa added on this thread for direct evidence questions.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@starkind.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: next steps for security questionnaire + SOC 2 / HIPAA status

Hi all — Marissa from Security. Confirming the commitments and next steps from our security team: 

- SOC 2: we will attach a redacted SOC 2 Type II report covering the period 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30. If you need an auditor letter instead, tell us and we’ll request it from our auditor.
- SIG prefill: we’ll provide JSON and a PDF export named Stark_SIG_prefill_v1.pdf. The JSON in the current draft includes control references and links to the evidence map.
- Data residency / HIPAA: hosted accounts can be restricted to a US-only region; Dedicated or Private deployments provide stronger contractual and technical isolation. For HIPAA, our standard BAA covers processing of PHI on hosted and dedicated offerings when signed; I’ll attach a short BAA summary page to the evidence map.

Deliverables timeline: we’ll upload the updated prefill (JSON + PDF) and the evidence map to the Drive folder linked below by 2027-09-16 17:00 PT. After that, happy to hop on a quick 30-min technical walk-through with Jorge to go over evidence items.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-stark-security
HubSpot reference: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HS-45678

If Jorge prefers the SIG in CAIQ CSV instead, we can export to that format as well — just confirm.

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
